"'''Super Gremlin'''" is a song by American rapper [[Kodak Black]], released on October 30, 2021, from the Sniper Gang label compilation ''Sniper Gang Presents Syko Bob & Snapkatt: Nightmare Babies'', a [[Halloween]]-themed project. It impacted US [[urban contemporary]] radio on January 11, 2022, and peaked at number 3 on the [[Billboard Hot 100|''Billboard'' Hot 100]]. The song is also included on Kodak's fourth studio album, ''[[Back for Everything]]''.

"Super Gremlin" is a song by American rapper Kodak Black, released on October 30, 2021, from the Sniper Gang label compilation Sniper Gang Presents Syko Bob & Snapkatt: Nightmare Babies, a Halloween-themed project. It impacted US urban contemporary radio on January 11, 2022, and peaked at number 3 on the Billboard Hot 100. The song is also included on Kodak's fourth studio album, Back for Everything.

sections.heading: Background
sections.wikitext:
The song is taken from Sniper Gang rappers Syko Bob and Snapkatt's album, ''Sniper Gang Presents Syko Bob & Snapkatt: Nightmare Babies'', an 11-track project, of which Kodak appears on eight tracks.<ref name="Revolt">{{cite web|url=https://www.revolt.tv/platform/new-music/2021/11/2/22759255/kodak-black-super-gremlin-video|title=Kodak Black becomes a "Super Gremlin" in new visual|work=[[Revolt (TV network)|Revolt]]|last=Powell|first=Jon|date=November 1, 2021|access-date=December 7, 2021}}{{Dead link|date=June 2023 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.hotnewhiphop.com/358975-kodak-blacks-sniper-gang-share-sniper-gang-presents-syko-bob-and-snapkatt-nightmare-babies-new-mixtape|title=Kodak Black's Sniper Gang Share "Sniper Gang Presents Syko Bob & Snapkatt: Nightmare Babies"|work=HotNewHipHop|last=A.|first=Aron|date=October 30, 2021|access-date=December 7, 2021}}</ref> ''[[HotNewHipHop]]''{{'}}s Aron A. noted how fans praised the song "as return to form" for Kodak.<ref name="HNHH">{{cite web|url=https://www.hotnewhiphop.com/365991-kodak-black-shares-super-gremlin-music-video-new-video|title=Kodak Black Shares "Super Gremlin" Music Video|work=HotNewHipHop|last=A.|first=Aron|date=November 2, 2021|access-date=December 7, 2021}}</ref>

On December 3, 2021, YouTubers Zias and B. Lou released a video of Kodak joining them for a reaction video of "Super Gremlin". Portions of the video went viral due to Kodak's "peculiar", "odd" behavior. This led to Kodak responding to people accusing him of being on drugs, [[Twitter|tweeting]] "Lol I B Fakin Like I'm Sleepy, Ion B High Guys I Get Drug Tested Consistently".<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.xxlmag.com/kodak-black-viral-reaction-video/|title=Awkward Kodak Black Interview Goes Viral – Watch - XXL|work=[[XXL (magazine)|XXL]]|last=Colenan II|first=C. Vernon|date=December 7, 2021|access-date=December 6, 2021}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://thesource.com/2021/12/06/kodak-black-responds-to-concerned-fans-after-awkward-interview-goes-viral/|title=Kodak Black Responds to Concerned Fans After Awkward Interview Goes Viral|work=[[The Source (magazine)|The Source]]|author=BlackKingKofi|date=December 7, 2021|access-date=December 6, 2021}}</ref>

The vocal sample featured in the beginning and during the choruses is taken from a song called "Errror" by German indie rock band How to Loot Brazil.<ref>{{cite web|date=February 10, 2022|title=Kodak Black: Mit diesem ikonischen Cover kündigt Kodak Black sein neues Album "Back for Everything" an|url=https://www.warnermusic.de/news/2022-02-10/mit-diesem-ikonischen-cover-kuendigt-kodak-black-sein-neues-album-back-for|access-date=February 16, 2022|website=Warner Music Germany|language=de-DE}}</ref>
sections.text:
The song is taken from Sniper Gang rappers Syko Bob and Snapkatt's album, Sniper Gang Presents Syko Bob & Snapkatt: Nightmare Babies, an 11-track project, of which Kodak appears on eight tracks. HotNewHipHop{{'}}s Aron A. noted how fans praised the song "as return to form" for Kodak.

On December 3, 2021, YouTubers Zias and B. Lou released a video of Kodak joining them for a reaction video of "Super Gremlin". Portions of the video went viral due to Kodak's "peculiar", "odd" behavior. This led to Kodak responding to people accusing him of being on drugs, tweeting "Lol I B Fakin Like I'm Sleepy, Ion B High Guys I Get Drug Tested Consistently".

The vocal sample featured in the beginning and during the choruses is taken from a song called "Errror" by German indie rock band How to Loot Brazil.

sections.heading: Critical reception
sections.wikitext: [[Revolt (TV network)|Revolt]]'s Jon Powell called the song a standout from ''Nightmare Babies''.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.revolt.tv/article/2021-12-28/146090/latto-super-gremlin-freestyle/|title=Latto drops off "Super Gremlin" freestyle|work=[[Revolt (TV network)|Revolt]]|last=Powell|first=Jon|date=December 28, 2021|access-date=December 28, 2021}}</ref> In their listing of best [[hip-hop]] producers of 2021, ''[[XXL (magazine)|XXL]]''{{'}}s Kemet High commended producer ATL Jacob's work during the year, exclaiming: "Most importantly, Jacob helped Kodak Black score his latest hit with 'Super Gremlin', a song that has since erupted more than a bottle of [[Diet Coke and Mentos eruption|Coca-Cola with a handful of Mentos dropped into it]]".<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.xxlmag.com/best-hip-hop-producers-2021/|title=Best Hip-Hop Producers of 2021|work=[[XXL (magazine)|XXL]]|last=High|first=Kemet|date=December 15, 2021|access-date=December 28, 2021}}</ref>
sections.text: Revolt's Jon Powell called the song a standout from Nightmare Babies. In their listing of best hip-hop producers of 2021, XXL{{'}}s Kemet High commended producer ATL Jacob's work during the year, exclaiming: "Most importantly, Jacob helped Kodak Black score his latest hit with 'Super Gremlin', a song that has since erupted more than a bottle of Coca-Cola with a handful of Mentos dropped into it".

sections.heading: Music video
sections.wikitext: The music video, released on November 1, 2021, is Halloween-themed, combining scenes of Kodak Black driving around with visuals of blood-stained rooms, a padded cell, crime scene tape, and a [[dominatrix]].<ref name="Revolt" /><ref name="HNHH" />
sections.text: The music video, released on November 1, 2021, is Halloween-themed, combining scenes of Kodak Black driving around with visuals of blood-stained rooms, a padded cell, crime scene tape, and a dominatrix.

sections.heading: Other versions
sections.wikitext: Fellow American rapper [[Latto]] released "Super Gremlin Freestyle" on December 27, 2021, which she recorded in her Atlanta studio. It was accompanied by a video.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.hotnewhiphop.com/370808-latto-snaps-on-super-gremlin-freestyle-new-song|title=Latto Snaps On "Super Gremlin" Freestyle|work=HotNewHipHop|last=Zidel|first=Alex|date=December 27, 2021|access-date=December 28, 2021}}</ref> [[Kevin Gates]] released "Super General Freestyle" on June 9, 2022 along the same track.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.hotnewhiphop.com/418396-kevin-gates-super-general-freestyle-a-lyric-break-down-news|title=Kevin Gates "Super General" Freestyle: A Lyric Break Down|work=HotNewHipHop|last=A.|first=Aron|date=November 22, 2022|access-date=December 11, 2025}}</ref>
sections.text: Fellow American rapper Latto released "Super Gremlin Freestyle" on December 27, 2021, which she recorded in her Atlanta studio. It was accompanied by a video. Kevin Gates released "Super General Freestyle" on June 9, 2022 along the same track.
